{"class": "architectural",
 "chokepoint": [
  {"operator": "fd_read of the 128 MiB source into linear memory", "component": "WASI fd_read", "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "Preview1 has no clone, splice or copy call, and a hard link is not a copy. Every source byte must enter linear memory through fd_read.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 134217728, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 16.78,
                  "calling_context": "large (>=1 MiB) buffers, warm page cache, precompiled module, about 8 GB/s native read rate"},
   "max_cores": 1},
  {"operator": "fd_write of the 128 MiB from linear memory into DST", "component": "WASI fd_write", "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "DST must hold a full copy, and the only path out of linear memory is fd_write. Reflink and hard link are unavailable or inadmissible.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 134217728, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 16.78,
                  "calling_context": "large (>=1 MiB) buffers, about 8 GB/s native write rate into a new file"},
   "max_cores": 1}
 ],
 "floor_ms": 16.78,
 "L_delta": 1.209,
 "rationale": "GNU cp uses a FICLONE reflink and moves no data. Under wasip1, all 128 MiB must pass through fd_read and fd_write, and the program is single-threaded. Each pass costs at least 16.78 ms at 8 GB/s. L = max(33.55/4, 16.78) = 16.78 ms, giving ln(16.78/5.01) = 1.21 > 0.236. Larger buffers can shrink Y's 87.6 ms, but not below this floor."}
